maps.name: Cargo Port
maps.summary: Strongest weapon run on Dalniy Island. Works without keys; the Port crane key unlocks the deep route.

nodes.label: Safe-side entry
nodes.loot: Standard containers on the quieter side
nodes.tip: Work the safer side first, then push toward the barges.

nodes.label: Barges
nodes.loot: Barge containers, military gear; small/big military crates on floating barges
nodes.access: Crate keys for the military crates
nodes.tip: Shotgun as secondary. Automatics burn too much ammo.

nodes.label: Portal → Crane
nodes.tip: Portal is near the end of the barge route.

nodes.label: Weapon Barge
nodes.loot: Weapon crates; players report PKM, VAL, SVD
nodes.tip: Highest-value stop on the map. Leave once you've hit it.

nodes.label: Back buildings
nodes.loot: Mixed containers to fill your pack on the way out
nodes.tip: Top off here instead of detouring.

maps.name: Military Base
maps.summary: Short, crate-dense route. Hangars first, then barracks if you have a key.

nodes.label: Hangar A
nodes.tip: Clear only what blocks you. Save meds.

nodes.label: Hangar B
nodes.tip: Hangars 148 and 209 need their own keys.

nodes.label: Barracks #1 Armory
nodes.loot: 2× AS Val, AKMs, mags (2F grate door)
nodes.tip: Key may spawn in the office opposite the barred room or a classroom. A classroom floor hole leads to 2F.

nodes.label: Barracks #2 Armory
nodes.tip: Go up carefully; armory sits in the same spot as Barracks #1.

maps.name: Dogorsk
maps.summary: Rotating events: helicopter and checkpoint spawns can swap each raid. Extraction points are dynamic.

nodes.label: House 1 rooftop
nodes.tip: Keep moving on the stairs.

nodes.label: Anomaly helicopter
nodes.access: Climb the wall of House 2, drop to the other section
nodes.tip: Main prize of the house route.

nodes.label: Police-area event
nodes.loot: Helicopter ringed by Flowermen, or a checkpoint with weapon crates
nodes.tip: Station basement has a Lock actuator board door with high-tier loot.

nodes.label: Tunnel helicopter
nodes.tip: Not every raid.

maps.name: Ozernoe
maps.summary: Mid-risk mix of weapons and meds. Forest helicopter can be swapped for a ZIL convoy.

nodes.label: Forest helicopter
nodes.loot: Helicopter + three weapon crates (or ZIL convoy)
nodes.tip: Approach slowly; watch for mines.

nodes.label: Fire-station road ZILs
nodes.loot: Two ZIL trucks, 2–3 crates of weapons and meds
nodes.tip: Quick, low-commitment stop.

nodes.label: Boss spawn
nodes.tip: Swarms can't sting you inside the church; use it to regroup.

maps.name: Shegolskoe
maps.summary: Submerged helicopter, floating houses, and numbered attics.

nodes.label: Underwater helicopter
nodes.loot: Two crates near the rear section
nodes.tip: From the tail, crates are on the left; from the cockpit, on the right. Marker position is approximate; not yet confirmed on this map.

nodes.label: Floating houses
nodes.tip: Find the portal first. Marker position is approximate; not yet confirmed on this map.

nodes.label: Attics #4/#8/#11/#15
nodes.tip: Keys come from the Keys fuse recipe. Marker position is approximate; not yet confirmed on this map.

nodes.label: Surveillance room
nodes.tip: 3rd floor of the apartment building on the north side.

maps.name: Dam
maps.summary: Dense indoor loot behind keyed and electric doors.

nodes.label: West electric door
nodes.tip: Needed for the Rosin Stockpile objective.

nodes.label: East storage
nodes.tip: Grab the key from the director's office first.

nodes.label: Central interior
nodes.tip: Good group target.

nodes.label: Severniy Veter helm
nodes.loot: Captain's safe: AKS-74U, Molotovs, ammo, log page
nodes.access: Captain's key (from the Factory roof crate)
nodes.tip: SE side of the southern waterfront.

maps.name: Headquarters
maps.summary: Best early-to-mid game farm for a basic combat kit.

nodes.label: Northern bunker
nodes.tip: Quiet solo option.

nodes.label: Southern bunker
nodes.tip: Driver's first aid kits are common on the southern edge.

nodes.label: Wrecks & pickup trunk
nodes.tip: Sweep the road after a bunker.

maps.name: Downtown
maps.summary: Large urban map with room to avoid traffic. Police and SWAT enemies.

nodes.label: Suspended train cars
nodes.loot: Weapon crates; backpacks around the trains
nodes.tip: Open the backpacks: keys and valuables.

nodes.label: Coble Hill Inn
nodes.tip: Better as a team.

maps.name: Park
maps.summary: Hard map. Go in for the underground lab with keys and fire.

nodes.label: Lab entrances
nodes.tip: Entrances: Restaurant kitchen door, south Greenhouse planter grate, north-central Greenhouse stairs.

nodes.label: Lab south door
nodes.tip: Fire works well here.

nodes.label: Lab Armory & AM vault
nodes.access: Armory key (Turned Soldier on lab steps), AM vault key (lab loot)

nodes.label: Flowerman nests
nodes.tip: Leave lure flowers until you're ready.

maps.name: Gigastructure
maps.summary: Gravity-warped maze with generous loot. Navigation is the real threat.

nodes.label: White-door storage
nodes.access: Storage room key (random world loot here)
nodes.tip: Run it in cheap gear until you know the landmarks.
